about: Skills by case. Each project turns cases on in .claude/skill-cases.local.json ({"on": ["ui-design", ...]}); the session-start hook lists the skills for the cases that are on. One home per job: each case names the kit skill that owns it, which loads its own references on demand. Load at most two skills per unit of work. Community skills are read before first use. The kit owns this file; projects do not edit it. A case with a "plugin" names a standby plugin: off globally, so its skill list costs nothing elsewhere; session start says how to switch it on in a project that turned the case on.

cases.name: UI/UX design
cases.when: a screen, flow, component, form, error message or UI copy is being designed or built
cases.notes: ui-craft holds the steps and loads one reference per topic; a project's own visual style lives in its standards.

cases.name: Motion
cases.when: a transition or animation is added or changed
cases.notes: ui-craft's motion reference; each project sets its own motion limits.

cases.name: UI/UX review
cases.when: a built screen or flow is reviewed before a PR

cases.name: Building a feature
cases.when: new behaviour is planned and built

cases.name: Debugging
cases.when: a bug, a failing test or unexpected behaviour

cases.name: Review before a PR
cases.when: a branch is ready for its Pre-PR Deep Sweep

cases.name: Security-sensitive work
cases.when: auth, crypto, secrets, input handling or anything that sends data off the device

cases.name: Data pipelines
cases.when: Airflow, dbt or data lineage work

cases.name: API design and testing
cases.when: an HTTP API is designed, mocked, tested or monitored with Postman
cases.notes: The plugin brings its own entry skill, postman:api-engineer; it is not kept in vendor/, so it is named here, not listed.

cases.name: Cloudflare platform
cases.when: Workers, KV, R2, D1, Wrangler or other Cloudflare services

cases.name: Learning the decisions
cases.when: the owner wants a decision explained
